comparison_with_8m_model.same_square: ground cells with centres inside x -554..444, y -2150..-1152
comparison_with_8m_model.how_to_read: The two runs differ in more than cell size. In the 8 km model water from the surrounding area flows into this square; the local model has no inflow across its edges and loses water there. The lower flooded area of the 2 m run is therefore not a measure of the effect of resolution alone.
